subject: design/review-feedback-capture
statement: The review-feedback ledger is a **per-subject directory of append-only markdown entry files plus a docgate-folded machine projection** (`design-brainstorm:review-feedback-capture-tech-design#D-1`) — the PRD-ledger pattern, giving a human-readable/diff-reviewable face and a native machine face for FR-5. Entries are written **only by a coded writer**, fed through **one consumer-side `CaptureSource` port** with two adapters — doc-review and code-host — so the writer core imports no adapter (`#D-3`, AP-1/AP-3/RW-3). The writer **tags each entry's typed disposition + stable outcome-ref at the observed resolving event** — never by inference (`#D-2`, AP-18/I3). Entries cite as `review-feedback:<subject-stem>#<entry-anchor>`, carry a **stable** outcome-ref (merged sha / PR / amendment id, never a working-branch sha) and **one-directional** cross-links to reviewer M2 / Argus `E-n` (NG-5); `Learned-from: review-thread` resolves to a `review-feedback:` anchor through the amendment model's **existing free ref slot** (no model change — `#D-4`/F-6), **enforced** by a registry-born docgate resolution check (`#D-4`, AP-10). FR-5's measures are **ledger-native** — disposition counts + applied/decline ratio over disposed entries + an `edit_distance` frozen at write (`#D-5`, AP-21). Captured comments are **verbatim, repo-internal, secret-gate-backstopped** (`#D-6`).
